name: Bloodpetal Zapper

narrative.offerRewardText: Looks like this is going to work perfectly, adventurer. Now remember, if you see any of those pests around, don't hesitate to use that zapper!
narrative.requestItemsText:
For the zapper to work, it needs a sample of the target creature. Head out into the crater and collect a Bloodpetal sprout. Then I can calibrate it to work on Muigin's little friends...

If he weren't so stubborn, we could be on our way home, already... But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 52 to 53, 16,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Larion and Muigin
quests.objectiveText: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Marvon's Workshop
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
